decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-72ecae3c2fc1] names one specific metric, `cilium_triggers_policy_update_total`, and says it is removed in 1.17. It is listed under the upgrade guide's "Removed Metrics" section, next to the related policy-update trigger metrics [ev-070e2e78535d] and [ev-fd031f140d8c]. Together these state the subject and the change (type removed) clearly. An engineer can write the open aspects from this: applicability is environments that collect or query this Cilium metric, and the consequence is that the series is no longer exported, so dashboards and alerts that use it get no data. Confidence is low because the evidence never says whether the metric was on by default or describes the impact on consumers; those parts follow from the removal rather than being stated.
